import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[0]
    return (params[1] + params[2]*x + params[3]*x**3 + params[4]*v + params[5]*x*v + params[6]*x*x*v
            + params[7]*np.cos(w*t) + params[8]*np.sin(w*t)
            + x*(params[9]*np.cos(w*t)))
